svg.text: Single-page model • 28 collection entities • document fields are attributes • relationships use paths, document IDs and reference identifiers
Each entity represents a collection/subcollection document structure. [ID] is the document path key; ordinary fields are attributes, not relationships.

foods.nutrition, foodLogs.foodItems and exerciseLogs.exercises are map/array attributes, not collection entities. Nested IDs such as foodItems[].foodId are shown as attribute paths, not extra entities.

Pale solid lines show user ownership and path/subcollection nesting. Blue dashed lines show logical identifier associations; endpoint labels give logical cardinalities. Weight history has at most one state index per user.

Food catalogue/recipe/saved-meal associations with dated foodLogs are many-to-many through embedded entry identifiers. A shared date is interpreted within the same user. recordId has alternative guided/wearable sources.

Firestore does not enforce SQL foreign keys or cascading deletion. Optional historical identifiers may outlive a removed source. Key attributes are shown; the data dictionary supplies the complete fields. Local health caches are outside this cloud model.
